selection_rule: A full pass requires all six gates. Partial or control-pulse entries do not count as passes, and measurements from different physical carriers may not be stitched together.
preferred_reopening_architecture: One programmable qubit-plus-ancilla carrier combining work-characteristic interferometry, endpoint tomography, and a Bargmann/Uhlmann loop under a source-frozen action calibration.
